mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), reducing isoniazid metabolism and increasing its serum concentrations, while isoniazid may inhibit cimetidine metabolism.
action: Monitor for isoniazid toxicity signs (peripheral neuropathy, hepatotoxicity); consider alternative H2-blocker (famotidine) or proton pump inhibitor; if concurrent use necessary, monitor INR if warfarin co-administered and liver function tests.
